test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an examination, 28% of the students failed in Hindi and 32% failed in English. If 20% of the students failed in both the subjects then the percentage of students who passed in both the subjects is:
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of students failed in Hindi (H) = 28%

Percentage of students failed in English (E) = 32%

Percentage of students failed in both subjects (H ∩ E) = 20%

**Formula used:**

Percentage of students passed in both subjects = 100% - (H + E - H ∩ E)

**Calculation:**

Percentage of students passed in both subjects = 100% - (28% + 32% - 20%)

⇒ Percentage of students passed in both subjects = 100% - (60% - 20%)

⇒ Percentage of students passed in both subjects = 100% - 40%

⇒ Percentage of students passed in both subjects = 60%

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
